verdict.rationale: Community reports show ZCode has a login flow with credits, and users run it under the GLM coding plan (Pro plan, plan multipliers, a coding-plan usage promotion). That indicates an existing subscription plan can be used inside the agent, but no first-party doc describes the sign-in or plan-linking flow. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of signing in with an existing subscription, details of which plans are accepted and how quota maps, independent hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: ZCode comes with a small amount of free credits after login.
They tried the Pro coding plan
the 1.5x usage promotion for GLM 5.2 on the coding plan
